# LocalYapper 2.1.0

A new look for the settings app and the overlay, and a long list of
fixes to recording, setup and downloads. Everything still runs on your
computer.

## New interface

- Flat and monochrome, in light and dark: ink on a plain background with
  hairline rules. Red is the only colour, and it marks recording, errors
  and anything destructive.
- Four pages as tabs in the title bar: History, Dictation, Voice and
  General. The app opens on History, which shows the record key, status
  and word counts above your transcripts.
- Settings are one row each: a label and a control, with the explanation
  in a tooltip.
- The overlay is a slim dark pill with red level bars. Drag it anywhere;
  it remembers the spot and stays on screen.
- The setup wizard is a single column with a step counter, and every
  step has a way forward.

## Dictation

- Pressing the record key before a speech model is downloaded now says
  so, instead of leaving the pill stuck on "Listening".
- Your clipboard is safer: content LocalYapper cannot read (copied files,
  spreadsheet ranges) is never wiped, and two dictations in quick
  succession put back what you had before the first one.
- A paste that never completes is given up after a while, and the text
  stays ready to copy.
- A brief audio glitch on Linux no longer ends the recording.
- Changing the speech model during a dictation no longer drops the rest
  of the text.
- Stops are aimed at one recording, so a late key release can never end
  the next dictation, and a stalled dictation ends with a message.
- Escape can be chosen as the cancel key again, and editing a hotkey
  during a recording no longer disables the cancel key.
- Reset hotkeys works even when a default is taken by another hotkey.

## Speech models

- The Voice page keeps showing a download that is running in the
  background, with its progress and a Cancel button, and "Check" can be
  cancelled while it repairs a model.
- Cancel works straight away, even while a partial download is checked.
- Busy servers are retried, and a connection that keeps dropping but
  makes progress keeps going.
- Model files are fetched over HTTPS only, and a model is never deleted
  while it is loading.

## Setup and settings

- A wizard resumed after closing the window shows the right microphone
  status and does not offer a download you already have.
- History: "More" no longer skips entries, and entries from earlier years
  show the year.
- Copy diagnostics works on macOS and Linux.
- The microphone list no longer says "Not connected" while it loads.
- Each window gets only the permissions it uses.

## Install notes

Builds are not code-signed. See the README for the one-time steps on
Windows (SmartScreen) and macOS (quarantine flag and Accessibility).
macOS asks for Accessibility again after the update: remove LocalYapper
from the Accessibility list and add it again.
